error_derivation.off_core: The Q_Z0,E forcing rows are at most r_Q<=u from the raw core. Every ordinary column core lies outside all N_(2u)(R_j). Hence an ordinary n=0 square-root kernel reaching those rows crosses distance at least u. The shifted inverse bound and its spectral integral give2/sqrt(a) times exp(-t distance). Splitting the tail at t/2 and using the absolute halo count gives T_off before Q_Z0,E and tags.
error_derivation.residual_words: Every n>=1 square-root word has absolute aggregate norm <=K/sqrt(a)*eps^n*c_n, c_n<=1. Special factors have determining data inside the protected cover and carry no OUTSIDE tag. Ordinary factors contribute at most16 tag cubes each, so b_tag^(n+1) remains a safe overestimate of every word.
error_derivation.bound: If q<1, the whole-word tagged Gamma_sigma obeys ||Gamma_sigma-Gamma_ref||_Schur <=Delta_Gamma=J_Q*b_tag*[T_off+(K/sqrt(a))*q/(1-q)]. The first term pays ordinary off-core n=0 words; the second pays all residual words. All indices and ordinary/special words are summed in absolute row/column norm, not by counting a cancellation.
error_derivation.real_reference: Since Gamma_ref is real, ||Im Gamma_sigma||_2<=Delta_Gamma and ||Gamma_sigma||_2<=K_Gamma=K_ref+Delta_Gamma. These are explicit candidate bounds at the fixed native scale and contour. No actual value or strict pass is asserted.
